content.short: Genopets: Pixelton Arena is a Telegram mini app from Genopets for turn-based pet battles, rankings, and Energy rewards.
content.description: Genopets: Pixelton Arena brings the Genopets universe into Telegram through retro turn-based pet battles. Players summon a Genopet, challenge other players, improve moves and stats, earn Energy from matches, and climb the leaderboard for rewards. It works as a Telegram game experience tied to the broader Genopets ecosystem rather than as a wallet, token dashboard, or exchange.
